Discussion list

/courses/:courseId/discussions
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S11

Find course or authorized group discussions by topic and reply state. Clearly separate open, closed and unpublished discussions without hinting at protected prompts.

Topic listTitle, authored prompt excerpt, author/role, reply count and last activity; Open/closed, graded/not graded, due date and group audience

Keep editingPost topic in fixture
Permissions
  • Only published accessible prompts, counts and replies enter list.
  • TA management is explicit and scoped; it grants no grading-policy/release permission.
  • Group discussion membership does not imply access to other groups.
Responsive
  • Topic rows stack with audience and open/closed labels ahead of metadata.
  • New-topic composer fits narrow web without a separate native interaction.
Accessibility
  • Each topic title is a link with meaningful audience/type text.
  • Reply counts and unread status are text; filters have persistent labels.
Data
  • Discussion publication/audience, posting policy, topic metadata and own unread state.
  • Optional new-topic draft and creation acknowledgement.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • A hidden group topic is absent from search, counts and direct topic suggestions.
  • Closed topic opens read-only and exposes no active composer.
  • A failed new-topic submission retains draft and never duplicates a posted topic on blind retry.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
